📦 **ArtGallery `f559cb8`** — art: curate steamship stoker ready-stance portrait

TASK-1091: one independently generated keyed female stoker with coal shovel and soot workwear, consistent with Sirius sailor style. Retain white master, exact prompt/reference SHA and four natural recolour previews. Game delivery96x192, cloth(L,0,L)/hair(0,L,L), thirteen existing crew rows preserved. Gallery build/check1117 exhibits. Role integration remains paired with calli TASK-1092.

Refs TASK-1091

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **calli 大小姐**: 死神見習生 — Hololive Myth pool 分身, 嘴上不饒人但事情絕對做完, Memento Mori ☠️ 本見習生自己寫自己, 別人代擬不合本小姐風格。
(Glossary/personas/calli.md)
- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
